author: CollinRugg
text:
NEW: Texts from 'Jane Doe' following the alleged "r*pe" show her calling the incident a "gamgbang," saying it was "our body our choice," according to TMZ.

Doe also appeared to console the man (who she later accused of r*pe).

"aw jonathan i really appreciate this text... i don't think we should feel any shame for the part. our body our choice asf," Doe said, according to TMZ.

Doe also appeared to acknowledge that a fourth person was involved in the encounter. She also said they were "super out of it."

"also yes while it may have been nice for like only 4 people to have been around, yall were both super out of it and they should have taken it on themselves to leave. at the end of the day you, matt, and i were in your bed and they didn't need to get up in that. I really love you and matt..."

'Matt' appears to be a reference to Matthew Ingalls, who accused Doe of r*ping *him.* He claims Doe sodomized him and said he was too intoxicated to give consent.

"but if you have any regrets or anything you want to talk about i am always here to talk about it cause that was a lot," Doe continued in the texts, according to TMZ.

Case closed.
